lines.caption: "My Lord, under Section 420 of the IPC,"
"Stop, counsel. IPC 420? That no longer applies. Cheating is BNS 318."
That judge is an AI. And it just caught a law India replaced in 2024.
India has 5.64 crore court cases pending. And when your boss stops paying you, you just want to know what's next.
So we built न्यायमित्र. A friend in court.
Door one: सहाय. You just talk.
"My boss hasn't paid my salary for three months."
She asks one thing at a time, then gives you the path: where to go, what to carry, your deadline.
Door two: अभ्यास. You argue, the other side hits back, the bench scores you.
Argue against your own client? The bench notices.
"Counsel, by alleging dishonest intention against your own client, you are weakening their case."
Every voice you just heard is Gnani Timbre.
Justice should speak your language. The link is in the post.
